title: Questions
metaTitle: Questions about buying CS2 lots, Steam delivery and refunds
metaDescription: Answers on buying Counter-Strike 2 skins from {brand}, delivery by {method}, Steam trade protection, refunds, card payment and your account.
lead: Short answers about buying from {brand}. The full wording is in our <policies>policies</policies>.
stillNeedHelpBody: Write to us and we reply {replyTime}. Support hours: {supportHours}.

place.q: How do I place an order?
place.a: Sign in, link your Steam account and save your trade URL. Put the lots you want in your cart, open checkout, give us your contact and billing details, tick the two confirmation boxes and pay on our payment provider's secure page. Your confirmation email goes out as soon as the payment is confirmed.

account.q: Do I need an account to order?
account.a: Yes. Everything we sell is delivered to a Steam account, so checkout needs an account here with your Steam account linked to it. You can sign in through Steam, or register with an email and password and link Steam afterwards.

unique.q: Why can I only add one of each lot?
unique.a: Every lot in the catalogue is one skin in one condition, so a lot can only be bought once. A single order can hold up to {maxItems} different lots.

float.q: Will I get the exact float shown?
float.a: The label prints the float range for the condition, not a measured value for your copy. Every copy of a skin has its own float fixed at the moment it drops; yours falls somewhere inside the printed range, and Steam shows the exact figure once the item is in your inventory.

change.a: You can cancel free of charge at any point before {cancelBefore}. After that the lot is on its way and the cancellation wording at checkout applies. Write to {email} with your order number and we will stop it if we still can.

noEmail.q: I paid but did not get a confirmation email.
noEmail.a: Check your spam folder first, then open My purchases, where every order and its status is listed. If the order is there but the email is not, write to {email} and we will send it again.

how.q: How do I receive the lot?
how.a: As a {method}. Once your payment is confirmed we send the skin to the trade URL saved on your account, {usual}. Open Steam, go to Inventory, then Trade Offers, and accept it.

time.a: We send the offer {usual}. If we cannot deliver within {deadlineHours} hours of the payment being confirmed, we refund the lot.

requirements.q: What does my Steam account need?
requirements.a: A Steam account in good standing with no trade ban or cooldown, the Steam Guard Mobile Authenticator turned on for at least 7 days, a public inventory, and a current trade URL from that same account saved here.

protection.q: Why can't I trade the item straight away?
protection.a: Steam can hold items you receive under trade protection for up to {protectionDays} days, and accounts without the Mobile Authenticator can see trade holds of up to {holdDays} days. Those are Valve's rules, applied to every trade on Steam, and not something we set or can shorten.

expired.q: I missed the trade offer. What now?
expired.a: Write to us with your order number. If the offer ran out before you accepted it, we send it again where we can; if we cannot, we refund the lot.

safety.q: How do I know the offer is from you?
safety.a: Your purchase page shows the status of every lot and links straight to the offer once it is sent. The offer only hands you the skin you bought and never asks for anything from your inventory. We never ask for your Steam password or your Steam Guard codes.

when.q: When do I get a refund?
when.a: If we cannot deliver a lot within {deadlineHours} hours, if the offer fails for a reason on our side, or if Steam reverses the trade while the item is under trade protection. The full wording is in our <warranty>Item guarantee</warranty>.

withdrawal.q: Can I return a lot I no longer want?
withdrawal.a: Before delivery begins, yes, and at no cost. At checkout you ask us to start delivery straight away and confirm that you lose the {withdrawalDays}-day right to cancel once the trade offer is sent, so a delivered item cannot be returned because you changed your mind.

refund.q: How long does a refund take?
refund.a: We refund within {refundDays} days to {refundMethod}, in the currency you paid in. Your bank may take a few more working days to show it on your statement.

account.q: The trade failed because of my Steam account. Do I get a refund?
account.a: Yes. If the offer cannot be completed because the trade URL is wrong, the inventory is private, or the account carries a trade ban or a Steam Guard restriction, we refund the lot and tell you exactly what to change.

methods.a: By {cardMethods} card. You type your card details on the payment provider's own PCI DSS compliant page. We take no other payment method.

safe.a: We never store or process full card details. Every card payment runs on our PCI DSS compliant provider's hosted page, and your bank may ask you to confirm it with 3-D Secure, usually in your banking app.

currencies.q: Which currencies can I pay in?
currencies.a: {currencies}. You are charged in the currency chosen at checkout. If your card is held in a different currency, your bank may add its own conversion fee.

vatNo.a: {company} is not registered for VAT, so no VAT is charged and nothing is added at checkout.

vatYes.a: Yes. The price on the label includes VAT at the rate that applies to your order.

when.a: When you complete the payment on the provider's page. We only ask for the lot to be delivered once that payment is confirmed. If the payment is declined or you cancel it, nothing is charged.

what.a: Cosmetic items for Counter-Strike 2: weapon skins, knives and gloves. They change how a weapon looks in game and have no effect on how it plays.

store.q: Do you buy skins from customers?
store.a: No. {brand} is a store. We sell lots we source ourselves; you cannot list, sell or trade anything to us here.

rarity.q: What do classification, condition and quality mean?
rarity.a: Classification is the drop tier the game assigns, from Consumer Grade up to Covert, with knives and gloves marked ★. Condition (Factory New to Battle-Scarred) is the band the item's float falls in. Quality is Standard, StatTrak™ (which counts kills) or Souvenir (dropped at a Major).

affiliation.q: Are you connected to Valve or Steam?
affiliation.a: No. {brand} is an independent store and is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by Valve Corporation. Items sit in your Steam account under Steam's own terms.

who.a: Anyone aged {minAge} or over in a country we sell to. You can sign in through Steam or register with an email and password.

steam.q: What do you get from my Steam account?
steam.a: Your Steam ID and your public profile name, avatar and profile link. Steam confirms the Steam ID to us when you sign in; we never see your Steam password. The detail is in our <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>.

password.a: Choose “Forgot your password?” on the sign-in page and enter your email. If an account exists for it, we send a link to set a new one. If you signed in through Steam, sign in through Steam again instead.

delete.q: How do I delete my account or my data?
delete.a: Email {email} from the address on your account. We close the account and delete your data, apart from the order records we are required to keep by law, as set out in our <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>.
